This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to start or advance their career in data analytics. As a Data Analyst Trainee, you will gain hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting data, generating reports, and contributing to business insights while working closely with senior data analysts.

 Assist in collecting, cleaning, and organizing raw data from various sources.

 Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (fresh graduates are encouraged to apply).

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks with minimal supervision.


 Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.


 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.


 A self-motivated learner, eager to develop data analysis skills.


 Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, managing time and priorities efficiently.






Requirements


 Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.


 Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques.


 Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R for data manipulation.


 Basic understanding of database management and SQL queries.

 Flexible remote work environment.


 Opportunity to gain hands-on experience and mentorship from experienced professionals.


 Access to training and development resources.


 Opportunity for career advancement based on performance.

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Scientist Intern
jobs_results.description:
DNEG India has an open Junior Data Scientist Intern position in Jaipur for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live entry-level data science projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews.

About the role
As a Junior Data Scientist Intern at DNEG India, your core focus will be learning the full analysis cycle — clean the data, model it, explain it. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on learning the full analysis cycle — clean the data, model it, explain it alongside the core team
• Use Python, SQL, Pandas, Descriptive & Inferential Statistics, Data Cleaning on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Python, SQL, Pandas, Descriptive & Inferential Statistics, Data Cleaning, Matplotlib & Seaborn, Scikit-Learn Basics, Jupyter Notebooks, Excel, Analytical Thinking — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics), BCA/MCA or B.Com with analytics coursework based in or willing to work from Jaipur. You should be willing to learn Python, SQL, Pandas and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 3-month internship in Jaipur, Rajasthan, with a stipend of ₹25,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with your first complete, reviewed data science project. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

Expect to leave with real project experience, exposure to professional tooling and process, and mentorship that helps you plan a concrete next step in your career. Outstanding interns can convert to a full-time offer at the end of the internship.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics), BCA/MCA or B.Com with analytics coursework
• Graduating batch: 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: Python, SQL, Pandas, Descriptive & Inferential Statistics, Data Cleaning
• Also useful: Matplotlib & Seaborn, Scikit-Learn Basics, Jupyter Notebooks, Excel, Analytical Thinking
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Jaipur, Rajasthan or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 2-4 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours worked remotely, with a fixed daily stand-up
• Duration: 3 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: you will need your own laptop and a stable internet connection; software licences and tool access are provided by the company
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: DNEG India and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to DNEG India's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on learning the full analysis cycle — clean the data, model it, explain it alongside the core team; Apply Python, SQL, Pandas, Descriptive & Inferential Statistics to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics), BCA/MCA or B.Com with analytics coursework; Graduating batch 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of Python, SQL, Pandas (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Descriptive & Inferential Statistics, Data Cleaning, Matplotlib & Seaborn is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan or willing to work from there for the internship period.

jobs_results.title: Jr. Business Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating business processes, gathering and analyzing requirements, and recommending data-driven solutions to help achieve organizational goals. This role requires strong communication skills, business acumen, and the ability to translate business needs into technical and operational solutions




JOB REQUIREMENTS


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
06–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong understanding of business process modeling, requirements gathering, and SDLC (Agile and Waterfall methodologies).
Proficiency in tools such as MS Excel, Visio, JIRA, Confluence, or other business analysis and project tracking tools.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Experience with data analysis, reporting tools, or BI dashboards is a plus.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ACTIVITIES


Business Analysis
Analyze current business processes, workflows, and systems to identify areas for improvement.
Gather, document, and validate business requirements from key stakeholders.
Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications and user stories.
Facilitate workshops, meetings, and interviews to elicit requirements and align on solutions.
Support solution design and ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
Develop process models, wireframes, and documentation to support project understanding.
Conduct gap analyses and recommend enhancements to existing processes and systems.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including IT, product, and operations.
Reporting & Documentation
Prepare reports, dashboards, and business insights to support decision-making.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of business requirements, processes, and solutions.
Ensure all deliverables align with project goals and organizational strategy.


BENEFITS


Competitive salary and bonus structure
5-day working (Sat-Sun off)
All major government holidays are observed.

jobs_results.title: Data & Archiving Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Position Title:Data & Archiving Analyst

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 43460

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

As part of McCain’s digital transformation, we are investing significantly in our data platforms, governance practices, and enterprise information management capabilities. We are seeking an experienced Data Archiving Analyst to join our Data Platform Governance team and lead the development, implementation, and ongoing operation of McCain’s global data archiving and retention framework.

This role serves as the enterprise subject matter expert for data retention, archiving, and disposal across McCain’s global technology landscape, with a particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), and the Databricks Enterprise Data Platform. The successful candidate will help ensure that data is retained appropriately, archived efficiently, and disposed of in compliance with legal, regulatory, and business requirements while reducing organizational risk and storage costs.

What You’ll Be Doing.

Own and evolve McCain’s global data archiving and retention strategy, policies, standards, and operating procedures.Develop and maintain enterprise-wide data retention schedules aligned to legal, regulatory, and business requirements across multiple jurisdictions.Define and implement data disposal and defensible deletion processes that are auditable and compliant.Establish and manage legal hold processes in collaboration with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams.Lead the design, configuration, governance, and operation of SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) within McCain’s RISE with S/4HANA environment.Govern SAP archiving objects across key functional domains including Finance, Controlling, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Quality Management, and Plant Maintenance.Partner with SAP Basis teams and managed service providers to monitor archiving activities, content server capacity, and archiving performance.Ensure ILM residence and destruction rules are properly configured to support retention and automated disposition requirements.Define and enforce data lifecycle management policies within Databricks, including Delta Lake retention controls, VACUUM schedules, and time-travel management.Collaborate with data platform teams to apply data classifications, retention tags, and access controls using Unity Catalog.Design storage tiering and archival strategies that transition inactive data to cost-effective storage while maintaining recoverability and compliance.Serve as the primary escalation point and subject matter expert for enterprise data archiving and retention matters.Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into practical governance controls.Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary data accumulation, associated costs, and regulatory risks.Maintain data archiving and retention risk registers and communicate priorities, risks, and roadmap updates to senior stakeholders.Represent the archiving and retention function in governance forums, steering committees, and cross-functional initiatives.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.7+ years of experience in data management, data governance, enterprise data architecture, or a related discipline with a strong focus on data retention and archiving.Deep hands-on expertise with SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP archiving objects (SARA), residence rules, and destruction rules within large-scale S/4HANA environments.Experience working with SAP RISE with S/4HANA or comparable SAP cloud-managed service environments.Understanding of shared responsibility models associated with SAP cloud services and ILM operations.Knowledge of Databricks technologies including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, VACUUM operations, and data lifecycle management concepts.Experience developing and operationalizing enterprise-wide data retention policies across multiple business domains and jurisdictions.Knowledge of storage tiering strategies and archival storage solutions.Strong understanding of global regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX, tax retention requirements, and related regulations.Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across technical, legal, compliance, and business audiences.Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical governance controls and technical implementations.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.SAP ILM, data governance, privacy, or information management certifications.Certifications such as CDMP, CIPM, SAP certifications, or equivalent.Experience within food manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.Knowledge of industry-specific data governance and regulatory requirements.

About The Team.

The Data Platform Governance team is a global function responsible for enabling trusted, secure, and governed data across McCain’s enterprise technology ecosystem. The team works closely with business functions, regional teams, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, SAP technology teams, and data platform stakeholders to establish governance standards that maximize business value while reducing risk. As the Data Archiving Analyst, you will play a critical role in shaping McCain’s enterprise data lifecycle strategy and ensuring governance practices support long-term growth and digital transformation objectives.

About McCain.

Click Here to learn more about McCain and how we provide opportunities to make an impact that matters.

Leadership principles.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

AI & Digital Capabilities.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

The McCain Experience.

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success.
